## 0e71518de287

**Classification: reproduced defect (retained test/source contract drift).** Source SHA-256 from the audit assignment: `b08491afbcd80e85a28beb2fdda61563beb99519d6336a023b11cb942cbb7670`.

The portable task-test stage fails 1 of 6 tests. `test_rule_hash_and_all_canonical_pairs_are_exact_and_input_pure` expects `RULE_HASH == "f3552b0bd0f3"`, while the selected generator declares `"1e4e48495a33"`. The same source passes lint, self-check, and rule smoke, so the concrete defect is stale retained test metadata rather than demonstrated canonical-output divergence. The test also imports the legacy staged canonical helper and receives the portability warning described in F2.

Reproducer from `WORK/`:

```sh
python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles check 0e71518de287 --stage task_tests --timeout 180 --phase audit --out ../checks/audit-0e71518de287-task-tests
```

Result: exit 1; 1 failed, 5 passed. Evidence: `checks/audit-0e71518de287-task-tests/result.json` and `checks/audit-0e71518de287-task-tests/checks/task_tests.xml`.

Checked scope: generator call/schedule logic, validator, Python rule mirror, semantic rivals/witnesses, all retained tests, canonical-pair count, lint, self-check, and Racket rule smoke. Audit target was not modified.
